description: List the permits pulled by one contractor, identified by the contractor UUID from search_contractors. Returns up to 25 permits per page with the contractor's work history fields (dates, categories, values). Results carry no property owner name, owner mailing address or permit applicant name fields.

start.description: Instead of page: 1-based position of the first result to return, e.g. start=24 continues after result 23 (as named in `_notes`)

name: get_contractor_permits
title: Contractor's permits
